N.A.M.
SECTION 2.
August 22, 1935.

Memorandum
on
Movements of E. Sharapoff, Soviet Diplomatic Courier.

Evsey Sharapoff, 36, Soviet Diplomatic Courier, arrived
in Shanghai from the U.S.S.R. via Japan on August 20, 1935,
in the s.s. " President Mc Kinley ".
It is reported that he will proceed to the Soviet Embassy,
Nanking.

D.S.

Deputy Commissioner(Special Branch).
Information.

备忘录
关于
苏联外交信使 E. Sharapoff 的行踪。

Evsey Sharapoff，36岁，苏联外交信使，于1935年8月20日经日本乘“麦金莱总统号”轮船（s.s. "President Mc Kinley"）从苏联抵达上海。
据报，他将前往南京苏联大使馆。

D.S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. S, Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
D 6486
Date February 18, 1935.

Subject (in full)... A. SHURAPOFF, Soviet Diplomatic Courier.

Made by... D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by... [Signature] D.I.

Avsey Shurapoff, 35, Soviet diplomatic courier, arrived
in Shanghai from the U.S.S.R via Japan on February 12, 1935 in
the S.S. "President Coolidge". He holds diplomatic passport
No. 3099 issued on December 16, 1934 at Moscow which bears a
Chinese visa issued on January 1, 1935 in that city.
Upon his arrival in Shanghai Shurapoff proceeded to
the Soviet Consulate, No. 1 Yangpoo Road.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

档案编号 S. B. REGISTRY.
D 6486
日期 1935年2月18日。

主题（全称）... A. SHURAPOFF，苏联外交信使。

制作人... D.S.I. Prokofiev。转发人... [签名] D.I.

Avsey Shurapoff，35岁，苏联外交信使，于1935年2月12日经日本乘“柯立芝总统号”轮船（S.S. "President Coolidge"）从苏联抵达上海。他持有1934年12月16日在莫斯科签发的第3099号外交护照，该护照上有1935年1月1日在该市签发的中国签证。
Shurapoff 抵达上海后，前往杨树浦路1号苏联领事馆。

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

副总监（特别处）。

POLICE FORCE
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, 7- 5- 1935
To D.C. (Sp. Br.)

Sir,
Nanking political
agent approached discreetly
few days ago, now
states he is unable to
obtain the names of
the expelled students.
Endeavours made
through other sources
also failed.
Tambushang
Supt.
